_meta.description: Ingress contract for normalized Clipulse event batches sent to /api/v1/events/batch.

project_root.description: Normalized project scope key sent over HTTP/stdout/spool. It must not expose the raw local project path.

event_id.description: Stable event id computed after outbound normalization so HTTP, stdout, and spool handoff share the same idempotency key.

privacy_mode.description: Current public transport mode. v1 requires hashed project scope delivery.

file_deltas.description: Repo-scoped file deltas. Paths outside the resolved project root must be dropped before they reach this contract.

usage.description: Optional bounded usage metadata. Older adapters may omit every field; when present, values must be aggregate token/cost metadata rather than raw prompts, transcripts, source text, credentials, or local paths.
